description: Click any pixel of an uploaded image to get its color.

faqs.a: Move the mouse over the image for a live readout; click to pin the color to the picked list. Each pinned color has a copy button.
faqs.q: How do I pick a color?

faqs.a: Yes — each pinned color shows a copy button that copies the HEX value to your clipboard.
faqs.q: Can I copy the picked colors?

faqs.a: Images are drawn at most 800px on the longest side for performance; the sampled pixel still matches the displayed pixel.

howto: Move the mouse over it for a live HEX/RGB/HSL readout.
Click any pixel to pin it to the picked list.
Use the copy button on any pinned color.
title: Image Color Picker
